newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Bids fall further.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Bids fall further.

text.p: Cash bids for dark northern spring wheat continued to slide on Monday, keying off losses in MGE futures, and movement remained slow as farmers held out for higher prices.

"The farmers haven't really decided what to do yet but one thing is for sure, they're not going to sell at these prices," a Montana dealer said. "If the price keeps deteriorating we'll see a lot of grain going under (USDA) loan."
USDA on Monday said spring wheat conditions deteriorated in the week ended Sunday. USDA rated the crop 48 percent good to excellent, down from 50 percent the previous week.

Dealers attributed the decline to persistent dry weather in eastern Montana and North Dakota. While rains fell across those areas last week, dealers said the moisture came too late to revive the crops.
